fatigue_models.name: ExponentialDecay
fatigue_models.description: Current model: responsiveness decays exponentially with cumulative stim time, recovers during rest

fatigue_models.name: StepFunction
fatigue_models.description: Responsiveness drops suddenly after 30s continuous stimulation, recovers to 80% during rest

fatigue_models.name: HeterogeneousPopulation
fatigue_models.description: 50% of subjects have NO fatigue, 50% have HIGH fatigue (rate=0.025), matching real data's 49/51% habituation split

fatigue_models.name: SaturationModel
fatigue_models.description: PAC ceiling decays over session time (synaptic adaptation), partial recovery during rest
